new.brief: Creates a new event controller that will handle motion events.
new.md: Creates a new event controller that will handle motion events.

doc.md:
Tracks the pointer position.

The event controller offers [`EventControllerMotion::enter`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerMotion#event:enter)
and [`EventControllerMotion::leave`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerMotion#event:leave) signals, as well as
[`EventControllerMotion:is-pointer`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerMotion#property:is-pointer) and
[`EventControllerMotion:contains-pointer`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerMotion#property:contains-pointer) properties
which are updated to reflect changes in the pointer position as it
moves over the widget.

contains_pointer.brief: Returns if a pointer is within `self` or one of its children.
contains_pointer.md: Returns if a pointer is within `self` or one of its children.

is_pointer.brief: Returns if a pointer is within `self`, but not one of its children.
is_pointer.md: Returns if a pointer is within `self`, but not one of its children.

contains-pointer.brief: Whether the pointer is in the controllers widget or a descendant.
contains-pointer.md:
Whether the pointer is in the controllers widget or a descendant.

See also [`EventControllerMotion:is-pointer`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerMotion#property:is-pointer).

When handling crossing events, this property is updated
before [`EventControllerMotion::enter`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerMotion#event:enter), but after
[`EventControllerMotion::leave`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerMotion#event:leave) is emitted.

is-pointer.brief: Whether the pointer is in the controllers widget itself, as opposed to in a descendent widget.
is-pointer.md:
Whether the pointer is in the controllers widget itself,
as opposed to in a descendent widget.

See also [`EventControllerMotion:contains-pointer`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerMotion#property:contains-pointer).

When handling crossing events, this property is updated
before [`EventControllerMotion::enter`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerMotion#event:enter), but after
[`EventControllerMotion::leave`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerMotion#event:leave) is emitted.

enter.brief: Signals that the pointer has entered the widget.
enter.md: Signals that the pointer has entered the widget.

leave.brief: Signals that the pointer has left the widget.
leave.md: Signals that the pointer has left the widget.

motion.brief: Emitted when the pointer moves inside the widget.
motion.md: Emitted when the pointer moves inside the widget.
